name: FlashSpeed – Speed Optimization & Performance Booster
author: Matt Biscay

sections.description:
Make your WordPress site lightning-fast in minutes. FlashSpeed is the performance optimization plugin trusted by thousands of WordPress and WooCommerce site owners to dramatically improve page load times, boost Core Web Vitals scores, and increase conversions.

Why Site Speed Matters

  • 53% of mobile users abandon sites that take longer than 3 seconds to load
  • Every 1-second delay in page load time can reduce conversions by 7%
  • Google ranks faster sites higher in search results
  • Faster sites = better user experience = more sales and engagement

What FlashSpeed Does

FlashSpeed eliminates the bloat that slows down WordPress. Instead of loading dozens of unnecessary scripts, styles, and resources on every page, FlashSpeed gives you granular control over exactly what loads—and what doesn’t.

The result? Faster page loads, improved Core Web Vitals, better SEO rankings, and happier visitors who convert.

Free Features

✅ Asset Optimization – Disable unused WordPress assets (emojis, embeds, dashicons, jQuery Migrate)
✅ Google Fonts & Maps Control – Block or optimize Google Fonts and Google Maps loading
✅ Meta Tag Management – Remove unnecessary meta tags (RSD, WLW, shortlinks, generator tags)
✅ Pingback Protection – Disable pingbacks to prevent spam and reduce server load
✅ Custom Favicon – Set unique favicons for frontend and backend
✅ Self-Ping Prevention – Stop WordPress from pinging itself
✅ Query String Removal – Remove version strings from CSS/JS for better caching
✅ Password Strength Meter – Disable on non-essential pages to save resources

Pro Features – Take Performance to the Next Level

Upgrade to FlashSpeed Pro for advanced optimization and security features:

⚡ Instant Page Preloading – Preload pages before users click for instant navigation
⚡ Local Google Analytics – Host GA4 locally for faster loading and better privacy compliance
⚡ Security Headers – Add CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, and other security headers
⚡ Custom Code Injection – Add tracking codes and scripts without editing theme files
⚡ Post Revision Control – Limit revisions to keep your database lean and fast
⚡ Advanced Tweaks – Remove jQuery, enforce SSL, convert URLs to protocol-relative
⚡ Resource Hints – Add preconnect and preload hints for critical resources
⚡ Agency Features – Client controls, update management, email notification settings

Perfect For

  • 🛒 WooCommerce stores wanting faster checkout and higher conversions
  • 📝 Content sites needing better Core Web Vitals and SEO rankings
  • 🎨 Agencies managing multiple client sites with granular control
  • 💼 Business sites where every second of load time impacts revenue
  • 🚀 Anyone who wants a faster WordPress site without technical complexity

What Users Are Saying

“FlashSpeed reduced our page load time from 4.2s to 1.8s. Our bounce rate dropped by 35%!”

“Finally, a performance plugin that actually works and doesn’t break my site.”

“The Pro version paid for itself in the first month with increased conversions.”

Easy Setup, Instant Results

  1. Install and activate FlashSpeed
  2. Visit the FlashSpeed settings page
  3. Toggle the optimizations you want
  4. Watch your site speed improve instantly

No complicated configuration. No technical knowledge required. Just fast results.

Compatibility

  • ✅ WordPress 6.0+
  • ✅ WooCommerce 3.3+
  • ✅ PHP 7.4+
  • ✅ Works with all themes and page builders
  • ✅ Compatible with popular caching plugins

Support & Documentation

Need help? We’ve got you covered:

  • 📚 Comprehensive documentation
  • 💬 Fast, friendly support team
  • 🔄 Regular updates and improvements
  • 🛡️ Security-first development approach

Ready to make your WordPress site blazing fast? Install FlashSpeed now and see the difference speed makes.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “FlashSpeed”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  5. Navigate to FlashSpeed in your admin menu to configure settings

Manual Installation

  1. Download the FlashSpeed plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the zip file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Configure your optimization settings under FlashSpeed menu

After Installation

  1. Visit the FlashSpeed settings page
  2. Enable the optimizations you want (start with Asset Management)
  3. Test your site to ensure everything works correctly
  4. Use tools like Google PageSpeed Insights to measure improvements
  5. Fine-tune settings based on your specific needs
sections.faq:
Will FlashSpeed break my site?

No. FlashSpeed is designed to be safe and non-destructive. All optimizations can be toggled on/off individually, so you can test each feature and disable anything that causes issues. We recommend enabling features one at a time and testing your site after each change.

How much faster will my site be?

Results vary based on your current setup, but most users see 30-60% improvement in page load times. Sites with many unused assets (emojis, embeds, etc.) see the biggest gains. Use Google PageSpeed Insights before and after to measure your specific improvements.

Do I need a caching plugin too?

FlashSpeed works great alongside caching plugins like WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, or WP Super Cache. FlashSpeed removes unnecessary assets, while caching plugins optimize delivery. Together, they provide comprehensive performance optimization.

Will this work with my theme and plugins?

Yes! FlashSpeed is compatible with all WordPress themes and most plugins. It uses WordPress’s built-in hooks and filters, so it plays nicely with other tools. If you experience any conflicts, simply disable the specific optimization causing the issue.

Is FlashSpeed compatible with WooCommerce?

Absolutely! FlashSpeed is fully tested with WooCommerce and can significantly improve checkout page speed, which directly impacts conversion rates. Many WooCommerce store owners use FlashSpeed to boost sales.

What’s the difference between Free and Pro?

The free version includes essential asset optimization and meta tag management—perfect for most sites. Pro adds advanced features like Instant Page preloading, local Google Analytics, security headers, custom code injection, and agency management tools. Compare features

Will disabling assets affect functionality?

FlashSpeed only disables assets that are typically unused. For example, WordPress emojis are rarely needed on business sites. However, if you use a feature (like embeds), don’t disable it. Test each optimization to ensure your site functions as expected.

Does FlashSpeed improve Core Web Vitals?

Yes! By reducing the number of assets loaded, FlashSpeed improves Largest Contentful Paint (LCP), First Input Delay (FID), and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)—the three Core Web Vitals metrics Google uses for ranking.

Can I use FlashSpeed on multiple sites?

Yes! The free version can be used on unlimited sites. FlashSpeed Pro licenses are available for single sites, 5 sites, or unlimited sites depending on your plan.

How do I disable Google Fonts?

Go to FlashSpeed > Assets and enable “Disable Google Fonts”. This prevents Google Fonts from loading, which can save 100-300ms on page load time. Make sure your theme has fallback fonts defined in its CSS.

Will this help my SEO?

Yes! Site speed is a confirmed Google ranking factor. Faster sites rank higher, have lower bounce rates, and provide better user experience—all of which improve SEO. FlashSpeed also helps you remove unnecessary meta tags that can clutter your HTML.

Is FlashSpeed GDPR compliant?

Yes. FlashSpeed doesn’t collect any user data. The Pro version’s Local Google Analytics feature actually improves GDPR compliance by hosting analytics locally instead of loading from Google’s servers.

How often is FlashSpeed updated?

We release regular updates to ensure compatibility with the latest WordPress versions, fix bugs, and add new features. FlashSpeed is actively maintained and supported.

What if I need help?

We offer support through the WordPress.org forums for free users and priority email support for Pro users. Our documentation covers common setup scenarios and troubleshooting steps.

Can agencies use FlashSpeed for client sites?

Yes! FlashSpeed Pro includes Agency features specifically designed for managing client sites, including the ability to lock settings, control updates, and manage email notifications.

Does FlashSpeed work with page builders?

Yes! FlashSpeed is compatible with Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, WPBakery, and all other major page builders. It optimizes WordPress core assets without interfering with builder functionality.
sections.changelog:
3.1.0 – 2025-12-03

  • Security – Add comprehensive header injection validation with control character filtering
  • Security – Implement Content Security Policy (CSP) validation with directive whitelisting
  • Security – Add ReDoS protection to all regex operations (Google Maps, Google Fonts, Pingback)
  • Security – Add input validation and PCRE limits to prevent regex-based DoS attacks
  • Improvement – Replace output buffering with targeted WordPress filters for better performance
  • Improvement – Remove Google Maps/Fonts via script/style loader filters instead of HTML parsing
  • Improvement – Remove pingback links directly via wp_head action instead of output buffering
  • Improvement – Add static caching to settings schema generation to prevent redundant processing
  • Improvement – Optimize settings retrieval with static caching to reduce database queries
  • Improvement – Add comprehensive error handling for wp-config.php modifications
  • Improvement – Implement automatic backup creation before wp-config.php changes
  • Improvement – Add syntax validation (php -l) before applying wp-config.php modifications
  • Improvement – Add automatic rollback mechanism on wp-config.php modification failure
  • Improvement – Remove duplicate emoji removal code to improve performance
  • Improvement – Add robust output buffer error handling with level checks and shutdown handlers
  • Improvement – Add error logging for regex failures when WP_DEBUG is enabled
  • Improvement – Implement graceful degradation on regex errors
  • Fix – Remove ~128 lines of complex buffer management code
  • Fix – Eliminate buffer overflow and nesting issues
  • Fix – Reduce memory usage by eliminating full HTML output buffering
  • Performance – Significant reduction in CPU usage (no regex on full HTML output)
  • Performance – Reduced memory footprint (no HTML buffering)
  • Performance – Faster execution time (targeted filters vs full page processing)

3.0.0 – 2025-11-10

  • Improvement – brand-new JSON schema-driven settings UI
  • Improvement – add CodeMirror editor refresh on tab switch
  • Improvement – minify GA4 analytics and Instant Page scripts
  • Improvement – validate delay value and add data-wp-strategy attribute to script tag
  • Improvement – remove duplicate oembed discovery links removal
  • Improvement – code refactoring, prune dead code
  • Improvement – update tom-select vendor files

2.1.0 – 2025-09-06

  • Update – Zen Settings, FS
  • Fix – translations loading too early
  • Fix – admin notice output to prevent XSS vulnerabilities
  • Improvement – WooCommerce HPOS compatibility
  • Improvement – favicon handling
  • Improvement – agency features list
  • Improvement – preconnect/preload link tag generation
  • Improvement – tracking code sanitization
  • Improvement – instant page script loading
  • Improvement – wp-config.php file permission checks

Older versions changes can be found in the changelog
